title: Count guard scripts in coverage
description: scripts/ is 610 lines at 0% because the v8 provider only counts code loaded in the test process, and the guards run as child processes. Decide and implement one option. A (current): accept, assert exit codes only. B: allowJs true in tsconfig and import release.mjs and check-git-identity.mjs in-process (both already have main() guards, so they import safely). C: also refactor check-adrs.mjs to a main() export like its sibling, since it executes and process.exits on import today. B plus C is the recommendation. Needs an ADR if the threshold policy changes.
author: Tomislav Zorcec

comments.text:
**What changed.** Guards are now counted in coverage, not just exercised. `check-adrs.mjs` was refactored into an importable `runCheck(root)` returning `{ok, adrCount, problems}` plus a thin `main()` owning output and the exit code — the same boundary `check-git-identity.mjs` already had. `allowJs: true` in tsconfig plus adjacent `.d.mts` declarations let the suite import all three guards with types. New in-process suites: `adrs-in-process` (4), `identity-in-process` (9), `release-in-process` (6). `scripts/**/*.mjs` thresholds pinned at 47/41/76/47, just under the measured 47.63/41.66/76.92/47.63, so any regression fails the build.

**Red to green proof.** The first in-process test killed its own worker: importing the guard executed the checks at import time and called `process.exit(1)` — suite failed with "process.exit unexpectedly called". After the refactor the same file is 4/4 green. The CLI contract is unchanged: byte-identical stdout and exit 0 on the real repo, and all 12 child-process ADR cases still pass, so neither layer is redundant with the other.

**Trap avoided.** The first draft of the new test file carried literal decision ids, and the real-repo guard failed with rule (a) dangling references to the test file itself. Ids are now assembled at runtime via `orphanId()` — the same reason `check-adrs.test.ts` uses `adrId()`.

**Verification.** pnpm check green: typecheck + lint + 84 tests passing, 21 todo across 17 files (65 to 84). Coverage green with the new scripts thresholds: check-adrs 84.18%, identity 23.11%, release 35.23%.

**Coverage still to grow.** identity and release in-process suites pin only the pure predicates so far; the CLI paths (`main()`, collectCommits, pushCommits) remain child-process-only. Deliberate: this ticket was "count the guards", and the thresholds ratchet upward from here.

No changeset: guard and test tooling only, no user-visible contract change.
comments.author: agent
